title: Rex and the Hay That Floated
synopsis: After a drying day, a hay tedder fluffs the cut grass while Rex and Molly try to decide whether the field is waving at them.
continuity_state: Before: The hayfield has been mown and cut grass lies in spread strips. It has not yet been raked or baled. After: On a following dry day the field has been fluffed with a tedder to expose more hay to sun and air. The grass continues drying, not yet baled. Rex and Molly invent a quiet two-tail wave together.
